description: This file defines the MathArithmeticException class, a custom exception class used in the Apache Commons Math3 library to represent arithmetic errors with support for localization and context information.

classes.name: MathArithmeticException
classes.description: A custom arithmetic exception class that extends RuntimeException and implements ExceptionContextProvider, providing localized messages and exception context for more informative error handling.

methods.name: MathArithmeticException
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception context with a localized arithmetic exception message.

methods.name: MathArithmeticException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a localizable pattern and arguments to initialize the exception context with a specific message.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the exception context associated with this exception, containing message and localization details.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Overrides the default method to return the localized message from the exception context.

methods.name: getLocalizedMessage
methods.description: Overrides the default method to return the localized message from the exception context.
